settings.title: Metrics settings
settings.intro: The calendar and thresholds every flow-metrics report is derived against. A save applies to the whole unit.

field.hoursPerDayHint: Converts logged worklog seconds to man-days.
field.holidaysHint: ISO dates (YYYY-MM-DD) excluded from every working-day calculation.
field.agingPercentilesHint: Must include 85 (the data-quality overview reads it by name).

settings.saveForbidden: Only administrators can edit metrics settings
settings.saveInvalid: One or more fields are invalid

validation.hoursPerDay: Hours per day must be greater than 0 and at most 24
validation.timeZone: Must be a valid time zone, e.g. Europe/Warsaw
validation.weekendDaysInvalid: Weekend days must each be Monday .. Sunday
validation.weekendDaysAllWeek: Weekend days must not mark every day of the week as non-working
validation.commitmentGraceMinutes: Commitment grace must be 0 or more
validation.minSampleSize: Minimum sample size must be at least 1
validation.agingWindowItems: Aging-WIP window must be at least 1
validation.agingPercentilesEmpty: At least one aging percentile is required
validation.agingPercentilesRange: Aging percentiles must each be a whole number between 1 and 99
validation.agingPercentilesDuplicate: Aging percentiles must not contain duplicates
validation.backlogWindowSprints: Backlog window must be at least 1 sprint
validation.epicDriftDays: Epic drift threshold must be 0 or more

teamMembers.title: Jira members

field.validToHint: Leave blank for an open-ended (current) membership.

teamMembers.removeFailed: Could not remove the membership row
teamMembers.removeBody: This membership row for {{name}} will be permanently removed.
teamMembers.addOverlap: This person already has a membership covering that period — end or edit the existing one first.
teamMembers.addAccountUnknown: This Jira account is not known to any connection yet.
teamMembers.endConflict: This period now overlaps another membership row.
teamMembers.endInvalid: Could not end this membership — it may already have ended.

validation.validFromInvalid: Valid from must be an ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD)
validation.validToInvalid: Valid to must be an ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD)
validation.validToBeforeFrom: Valid to must be after valid from
